terminal_cases.title: 106×58 宽窗口
terminal_cases.expected: 左日志/PTY 77 列、分隔 1 列、右栏 28 列；无覆盖和截断
terminal_cases.observed: Real 106×58 PTY with 77-column left panes, one separator and 28-column sidebar; translated shell cursor verified.

terminal_cases.title: 106→80→106 列调整
terminal_cases.expected: 80 列隐藏右栏，保留日志/PTY 与 F6；恢复宽度后状态回到右栏
terminal_cases.observed: 106→80→160→106 column SIGWINCH and child stty sizes verified.
remaining_coverage: F6 interaction specifically while the screen is 80 columns.

terminal_cases.title: 日志焦点下缩至不足 5 行
terminal_cases.expected: 返回可用 PTY 焦点，光标可见，F6 不被不存在的日志区域拦截
terminal_cases.observed: Shrinking from log focus to 4 rows restored visible shell focus; restoring height restored the 18×77 child viewport.

terminal_cases.title: 日志回看
terminal_cases.expected: F6、PgUp/PgDn、Home/End、Esc 行为与底部提示一致
terminal_cases.observed: F6/PageUp/Home/End/Escape with actual retained stream output verified.
remaining_coverage: PageDown has not yet been tied to this report's named assertions.

terminal_cases.title: 同一输入批次的焦点变化
terminal_cases.expected: F6→PgUp→普通字符后输入到 PTY，日志回到 tail
terminal_cases.observed: One keyboard input chunk F6→PageUp→text restored shell input and the live log tail.

terminal_cases.title: 持续后台输出时人工输入
terminal_cases.expected: 命令编辑、退格、中文和粘贴不被日志或侧栏重绘破坏
terminal_cases.observed: Real wide and combining Unicode, manual shell isolation from streams and forwarded ordinary input verified.
remaining_coverage: Editing/backspace and bracketed paste during continuous output are not explicitly listed in this report.

terminal_cases.title: 并行任务与真实进度
terminal_cases.expected: 两项以上任务同时可见；无 total 不显示百分比；来源不同的相同 ID 不混淆
terminal_cases.observed: Two independent tasks and over-six-second silent elapsed state verified without fabricated completion percentage.
remaining_coverage: A native valid total and cross-provider duplicate native IDs were not exercised by this dashboard run; renderer/unit evidence is separate.

terminal_cases.title: stdout/stderr 及历史读取
terminal_cases.expected: 流来源明确，执行中即可见；read/wait 不重放已显示输出
terminal_cases.observed: stdout and stderr appeared once during execution; read/wait did not replay them or overwrite the shell.

terminal_cases.title: 文件与技能记录
terminal_cases.expected: 真实 READ/EDIT/DIFF 路径、计数、查询引用和技能状态准确
terminal_cases.observed: A successful real file write produced visible audit and diff.
remaining_coverage: Skill discovery/read distinctions, failed write audit and full diff lookup are not exercised by this dashboard report.

terminal_cases.title: Git 观察
terminal_cases.expected: 暂存/工作区/未跟踪项/冲突准确；失败标过期；无观测不报 clean
terminal_cases.observed: Real repository status and workspace-file refresh verified; actual Git HEAD short hash and subject displayed, an uncommitted edit preserved history, and a new owned commit appeared before its parent.
remaining_coverage: Staged/conflict and unavailable/stale/unknown states were not injected by this dashboard run.

terminal_cases.title: 显示与秘密边界
terminal_cases.expected: NO_COLOR 仍保留布局；JSONL/非 TTY 不接管屏幕；控制字符与可识别秘密不进入侧栏
terminal_cases.observed: NO_COLOR layout, dashboard-disabled, JSONL and non-TTY behavior verified; inner clear/alternate screen/extreme cursor movement stayed within the PTY pane.
remaining_coverage: Known-secret and hostile sidebar text injection are covered by separate tests, not explicitly by this physical PTY report.

terminal_cases.title: 退出与恢复
terminal_cases.expected: 正常退出和受控失败后原屏幕、光标、输入模式恢复；无残留任务
terminal_cases.observed: Ctrl-C normal frontend exit restored alternate screen, cursor, input modes and exact original termios.
remaining_coverage: Controlled compositor failure and residual process cleanup are not exercised by this report.
